# After-School Tutoring Program

- **Goal / definition of done:** deliver free, consistent after-school tutoring to ~**420 students**
  across 6 school sites each year, improving reading/math outcomes (FY26: 71% improved one+ grade
  level).
- **Owner:** [Sarah Chen](../people/sarah-chen.md), Director of Tutoring Programs; delivered on the
  ground by lead coordinator [Tasha Brooks](../people/tasha-brooks.md).
- **Budget:** ~**$1.2M**/year — the single largest program line
  ([operations](../context/operations.md)).
- **Status:** operating normally, but **funding is AT RISK.** Its primary funding dependency, the
  restricted [Hearthstone Foundation grant](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md), historically covered
  about half the budget and has just been **declined** for renewal.

## Funding dependency (multi-hop)
- **Primary funding:** the restricted [Hearthstone grant](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md) —
  relationship owned by Development Director [Daniela Cruz](../people/daniela-cruz.md) and foundation
  Program Officer [Diane Alcott](../people/diane-alcott.md).
- With the renewal declined, Cam and Daniela must close the gap (individual gifts, gala proceeds, a
  differently-scoped funder) before it reaches students or [Tasha's](../people/tasha-brooks.md) role.

## Open items
- Backfill plan for the lost restricted funding — top FY27 priority.
- [Sarah Chen](../people/sarah-chen.md) wants a plan, not just the bad news.
